user_story: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove items I no longer need.

positive.title: Successfully delete an existing task
positive.expected_result: The task is removed from the task list and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to delete a task that does not exist
steps: Attempt to select a non-existent task
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the task cannot be found or deleted.

negative.title: User is not authorized to delete a task
steps: Navigate to the task list as a user without delete permissions
Attempt to click on the 'Delete' button
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the user does not have permission to delete tasks.

edge.title: Delete the only task in the task list
steps: Navigate to the task list with only one task
edge.expected_result: The task list becomes empty and a confirmation message is displayed.

edge.title: Delete a task immediately after creating it
steps: Navigate to create a new task
Immediately after creation, navigate to the task list
edge.expected_result: The newly created task is successfully deleted and a confirmation message is displayed.
